revenueModel.text: Clients pay for merchandise they keep from a Fix or buy directly via Freestyle, plus a styling fee per Fix or an annual Style Pass fee, both credited toward purchases.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge clients a styling fee of $20 for each Fix, which is credited toward any merchandise purchased.
